body_lead: CHENNAI: The Tamil Nadu government is considering upgrading the Tambaram District Government Hospital into a full-fledged medical college, while exploring expanding its Nalam AI digital health platform to let patients schedule medicine collection and avoid long queues at government hospitals, Health and Family Welfare Minister KG Arunraj said on Sunday. Speaking to reporters at the airport, the Minister said the proposal to establish a medical college in Tambaram is under consideration and will be discussed with Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay before a formal announcement.
